value ()
call commands.read ("./book.txt") -> Ok (Entry "book.txt" "./book.txt" 33 60)
call commands.cat (Entry "book.txt" "./book.txt" 33 60) -> "Call me Ishmael.\nSome years ago.\n"
call text.trim ("world") -> "world"
call text.trim ("name") -> "name"
call commands.read ("./letters") -> Ok "./letters"
call commands.put ("./letters", [97, 10, 98, 10, 99]) -> ()
success "[Count \"call\" 1, Count \"ishmael.\" 1, Count \"some\" 1, Count \"years\" 1, Count \"ago.\" 1]\n\"hello, world\"\n\"hello, name\"\n1\n2\n\"\\\"tab\\\\there\\\"\"\n11\n8081\n"
error ""
